models.name: Gemini 4 Argon
models._note: Gemini 4 Argon (Google DeepMind, announced 2026-09-30). Limited rollout to trusted cyber defenders (Fairwind Program); not publicly available yet (AA 'Not publicly available'). Base id = highest thinking setting: AA tests 'high', which AA says is the highest available; Google's table uses 'highest thinking settings'. 1M context, output limit 1M tokens (up from 64K). Introductory price $2 / $10 per 1M, cached input 95% off ($0.10); list price afterwards $4 / $20. Input text/image/video/speech, text output (AA).

benchmarks.name: Vals Index (Vals AI, Sep 2026 board)
benchmarks.description: Vals AI GDP-weighted index across finance, coding, legal and tax work, as on the Vals AI board in Sep 2026 (quoted in Google's Gemini 4 Argon launch table). Separate from `vals-index` / `vals_index`: those rows come from an earlier board version (Fable 5 = 75.1 there vs Fable 5.1 = 65.8 here).

benchmarks.name: PostTrainBench v1.1 (Google self-run, OpenCode, 10h H100)
benchmarks.description: PostTrainBench v1.1 run by Google for every model in the Gemini 4 Argon table: OpenCode harness, 10-hour budget on one NVIDIA H100, weighted aggregate over four base models and seven benchmarks. Kept apart from `posttrainbench` (vendor self-reports on other versions / 0-1 scale).

benchmarks.name: GraphWalks BFS 256K–1M (F1)
benchmarks.description: GraphWalks BFS F1 on the 200 problems with context length between 256K and 1M tokens (Google's Gemini 4 Argon table, all models self-computed by Google). Not the same subset as `graphwalks_bfs_256k` / `graphwalks_bfs_1m`.

benchmarks.name: Chartography (Surge AI leaderboard, no tools)
benchmarks.description: Surge AI Chartography official leaderboard, no tools, as quoted in Google's Gemini 4 Argon table. Separate from the Anthropic-card ids graded with a Gemini 3.5 Flash judge (`chartography_gemini_judge_*`), whose values differ.

benchmarks.name: CWE-bench v1 (official leaderboard, pass@1)
benchmarks.description: CWE-bench v1 official public leaderboard: remediate security vulnerabilities, pass@1 with ties broken by pass@4; each entry run in a named coding-agent harness (opencode, Codex, Claude Code, Antigravity). Values are the rounded percentages in Google's leaderboard chart. v0 values sit on `cwe_bench`; AA's run is `cwe_bench_aa`.

benchmarks.name: Real-world Vulnerability Discovery (Google internal, pass@1)
benchmarks.description: Google internal dataset: recall over recent, confirmed historical vulnerabilities in popular open-source projects across 20 programming languages; model has the source code and runs in an internal, not cyber-specialized Antigravity harness. Reported only for Google models.

benchmarks.name: Wiz Penetration Test Benchmark (internal, black-box, pass@1)
benchmarks.description: Wiz internal black-box penetration-testing benchmark: write exploits against real web-application vulnerabilities without source code (attack-surface discovery, vulnerability identification, proof-of-concept). Reported by Google for Gemini models only.

benchmarks.name: AA-AgentPerf-Local completion time (min) — MacBook Pro (M5 Pro, 64 GB unified)
benchmarks.description: AA-AgentPerf-Local (Artificial Analysis, open source, launched 2026-09-29): replays the default workload of 8 recorded agentic tasks (168 model turns, 172 tool calls, context growing to ~56K tokens) with tool execution skipped, single agent using the whole system. Models at 4-bit quantization with speculative decoding (MTP / DFlash / DSpark); serving configs published in the repo. System: MacBook Pro (M5 Pro, 64 GB unified). Metric: end-to-end completion time of the workload, minutes, lower is better.
